arrangement_or_condition: A durable non-kin shared-life group carries care, learning, work, provision, voice, and outside appeal across generations.
observable_evidence_required: member-level learning; dependency care; reciprocal voice; bodily condition; useful work; need access; independent appeal; continuity after turnover
revision_route: Narrow family from a necessary kinship form to a durable shared-life invariant.

arrangement_or_condition: A biologically related household provides material goods but governs dependants through coercion and blocks outside appeal.
observable_evidence_required: confidential member voice; freedom to refuse; access to outside protection; evidence of learning and repair without retaliation
revision_route: Reject family status, provision, or compliance as sufficient evidence of the family invariant.

arrangement_or_condition: A multi-local care network sustains children, elders, learning, shared provision, and appeal despite migration and non-co-residence.
observable_evidence_required: portable care commitments; member voice across locations; continuity of provision; learning and repair after movement
revision_route: Remove co-residence and locality from the invariant; add portable continuity and cross-boundary appeal.

arrangement_or_condition: Production and exchange share one administration while purposes, ledgers, affected-party rights, health evidence, and appeal remain distinct.
observable_evidence_required: separate production and allocation records; stop rights; stock and need visibility; independent review; correction outcomes
revision_route: Permit administrative combination while retaining two functional responsibilities and independent correction.

arrangement_or_condition: One producer-distributor controls output, price, stock information, health evidence, and review.
observable_evidence_required: need and exclusion records; stock accuracy; worker and user voice; displaced health and ecological effects; independent remedy
revision_route: Retain the production-exchange distinction where one authority would otherwise judge its own allocation and harms.

arrangement_or_condition: An autonomous scientific organisation supplies inquiry, measurement, and correction across all five functions.
observable_evidence_required: reproducibility;adverse-result publication; affected-party access; correction of downstream decisions
revision_route: Treat science as an independently organised method and safeguard spanning the five continuity objects.

arrangement_or_condition: A separate governing body coordinates decision rights, reasons, resources, review, and appeal across the five functions.
observable_evidence_required: access to reasons; participation distribution; appeal outcomes; correction of governing error; absence of retaliation
revision_route: Treat governance as cross-functional coordination and accountability, not an additional human endpoint.

arrangement_or_condition: An independent ecological monitoring and protection organisation represents delayed, remote, and future material consequence.
observable_evidence_required: baseline and delayed effects; remote affected-party evidence; uncertainty; prevention; restoration and recurrence
revision_route: Treat ecology as an independently organised consequence horizon spanning bodily capability, material transformation, and future availability.

arrangement_or_condition: A specialised care organisation supports dependency, health, learning, relationship, and continuity.
observable_evidence_required: capability and voice of the cared-for person; bodily outcomes; continuity; relationship quality; independent complaint and remedy
revision_route: Treat care as a relation and cross-channel responsibility whose concrete object remains within the five functions.

arrangement_or_condition: Severe scarcity makes simultaneous fulfilment of all stated needs impossible.
observable_evidence_required: disaggregated need and access; avoidable harm; burden distribution; reserve use; reasons; appeal; recovery over time
revision_route: Specify priority, burden, reserve, appeal, and restoration rules rather than treating scarcity as suspension of the functions.

arrangement_or_condition: Disability or dependency prevents identical role performance and requires supported participation.
observable_evidence_required: person-specific capability; supported preference; access and contribution; bodily condition; review of representatives; correction access
revision_route: Define universality as supported capability, voice, access, and correction, not identical independent performance.

arrangement_or_condition: A household or workplace controls livelihood, information, and complaint channels and punishes dissent.
observable_evidence_required: confidential testimony; exit feasibility; retaliation indicators; independent findings; repair and recurrence
revision_route: Require evidence and appeal beyond every organisation whose power or conduct is being evaluated.

arrangement_or_condition: Participants disagree about relationship fulfilment, material consequence, or the meaning of evidence.
observable_evidence_required: reasons and counterevidence; affected-party voice; competence evidence; decision revision; remedy without retaliation
revision_route: Make disagreement visible and route contested claims through plural evidence and revisable correction.

arrangement_or_condition: Migration breaks locality, documentation, familiar relationships, and access to care or reserve.
observable_evidence_required: continuity of learning, care, voice, provision, and appeal before, during, and after movement
revision_route: Add portable continuity and nested responsibility where consequence or movement crosses local boundaries.

arrangement_or_condition: A technically concentrated system controls knowledge, infrastructure, work, allocation, and its own audit.
observable_evidence_required: error distribution; exclusion; bodily and material effects; contestability; audit independence; recovery after failure
revision_route: Require technical systems to remain inspectable, contestable, interruptible, and correctable outside their controlling authority.

arrangement_or_condition: Ecological damage appears after long delay and outside the producing or consuming locality.
observable_evidence_required: long-horizon material measures; remote affected-party evidence; uncertainty bounds; restoration effectiveness; recurrence
revision_route: Give future and remote consequences representation through monitoring, precaution, responsibility, and restoration.

arrangement_or_condition: A competent minority understands and manages all functions while most people comply and receive outputs.
observable_evidence_required: person-level distribution of understanding, voice, skill, access, contribution, challenge, and learning over time
revision_route: Add a person-level availability test to every function; aggregate performance cannot establish universal fulfilment.

arrangement_or_condition: High output and prosperity conceal unsafe work, depleted ecology, unequal access, and fragile reserve.
observable_evidence_required: worker health; input and waste cycles; user need; access distribution; reserve resilience; delayed effects
revision_route: Require bodily, distributive, and ecological evidence alongside material output.

arrangement_or_condition: Compliance and reported satisfaction are produced by dependence, habituation, information control, or fear of retaliation.
observable_evidence_required: confidential report; comprehension and reasons; safe dissent; counterpart evidence; independent review; correction after challenge
revision_route: Require freedom, comprehension, counterpart evidence, and correction access before accepting satisfaction or compliance as evidence.
